start: Admin app on forgeai.aakashpahuja.in, nothing waiting to be sent, MOVE on

steps.action: Open the admin app; it asks whether to move
user_sees: A question to move to app.mettleup.fit
must_not: A move while unsent work is waiting

steps.action: Say yes
user_sees: "Opening MettleUp… Tap here if nothing happens", then the admin app on app.mettleup.fit, still signed in
must_not: Asked to sign in again
A sign-in already on app.mettleup.fit written over

start: The owner was on Members with a filter

steps.action: Move
user_sees: Opens /members with the same filter on the new address
must_not: Sent to the home page instead

start: A hand-over with a bad "to" address

steps.action: Move with to = //other.site or /api/...
user_sees: Opens "/" on app.mettleup.fit
must_not: Sent to another site
An /api address opened

start: MOVE off

steps.action: Open the old address
user_sees: No move question; the desk stays
must_not: Moved anyway

start: Another website posts a hand-over form

steps.action: The form reaches app.mettleup.fit/api/move
user_sees: Sent to the sign-in page, nothing written
must_not: A desk signed in to someone else's gym

start: Desk on the old address

steps.action: Accept the move
user_sees: Signed in on app.mettleup.fit
must_not: Asked to sign in again

start: The hand-over sent to the old address itself

steps.action: POST /api/move on forgeai.aakashpahuja.in
user_sees: "Not found"
must_not: A hand-over page on the old address

start: The desk is already signed in on app.mettleup.fit

steps.action: Move again from the old address
user_sees: The new address keeps its own sign-in
must_not: The newer sign-in written over by the old one

start: A GET to the hand-over address

steps.action: GET app.mettleup.fit/api/move
user_sees: Sent to "/" (303)
must_not: A page that writes keys

start: A hand-over with odd letters in the sign-in

steps.action: POST with letters other than A-Z, 0-9, _ and -
user_sees: Sent to "/", nothing written
must_not: The odd text placed in the page

start: MOVE turned off then on

steps.action: Ask /api/moved
user_sees: move false while off, true with to https://app.mettleup.fit when on
must_not: A cached answer (it is no-store)
